label: 更简洁的 emoji 图标：柔和 2.5D

body.prompt:
Create exactly one original fictional non-human avatar for a school alumni profile. Subject: one friendly small apricot fox holding one small simplified muted-coral laptop, with a curious smile. The laptop is the only accessory. Center a complete, compact full-body silhouette within the middle 76% of a square canvas, suitable for a circular avatar and recognizable at 32 pixels. Use a genuinely transparent alpha background: no painted background, gradient, vignette, halo, aura, drop shadow, floor, scenery, or checkerboard. No lettering, logo, watermark, extra character, floating decoration, or additional prop. This is a friendly illustrated icon, not a photo or cinematic character render.

Minimal modern emoji icon illustration, with broad smooth rounded shapes and a friendly oversized face. Three or four clean color areas, simple dark dot eyes, tiny mouth, and one readable laptop shape. Gentle restrained 2.5D shading with no visible texture; nearly flat at thumbnail size. No dark contour outline, no fur strands, no realistic materials, no glossy specular lighting, no tiny details, and no cinematic rendering.
